resources.string: "Add your first saving or purchase goal."
"Earmarks reserve your existing recorded cash. They are not new income, spending or additional wealth. Saving a goal never transfers money."
"Pausing stops new scenario allocations. Existing earmarks stay reserved until edited or the goal is removed."
"Use the date of your latest earmark."
"Check the name (1–80 characters), positive target, nonnegative earmark and valid dates. The earmark date cannot be in the future."
"The earmark date cannot precede the ledger tracking start."
"Goal amounts must use the ledger currency."
"This goal no longer exists. Refresh the list."
"Goals could not be read or saved. Try again."
"Plans are unavailable. No previous dates or totals are shown."
"Remove %1$s? Its earmark is released in the plan. Recorded cash and transactions stay unchanged; no purchase is made."
"Total goal reserves exceed the supported amount range. Unreserved cash is zero."
"Goal reserves make recorded cash the lower spending limit."
"Recorded cash does not cover all earmarks, or cash is negative. Reconcile records or adjust earmarks; scenario dates are unavailable."
"Recorded cash is unavailable. Dates that depend on cash are withheld."
"Planning uses your Forecasts selection: %1$s, %2$s-month window, %3$s complete sample(s)."

"Capacity = max(1-month forecast income − consumption − contributions, 0), using the displayed rounded forecast amounts. At least 2 complete months are required. This is a scenario, not guaranteed future income."
"Not available: record at least 2 fully tracked, completed months."
"No positive monthly net flow in the selected historical baseline."
"The historical baseline or forecast exceeds the supported range."

"One shared queue: higher priority first, then earlier target date and older creation. Free recorded cash is assigned once; the same monthly capacity is then shared across active goals. Paused earmarks remain reserved."

"Future contributions are assumed at the end of each next full calendar month. No current-month income, returns, inflation or unrecorded bills are assumed. Change Forecasts to compare methods/windows."
"Target date has passed; more money remains to be earmarked."
"Target is due today and is not fully earmarked."
"No future month-end contribution date falls before/on this target date."
"Target is already earmarked and all goal reserves are covered by recorded cash today. This is not a historical achievement date."
"This priority scenario can cover the remaining target from unreserved recorded cash now. Save an updated earmark to record your allocation; no amount is auto-saved."
"Estimated from the shared capacity after higher-priority goals and cash assignments. The recorded earmark does not grow automatically."
"Paused: no new free cash or future capacity is assigned."
"The scenario completion date is outside supported years."
"This scenario is ready by the target date; it is not a guarantee of affordability."
"This scenario is later than the target date. Review priority, target amount, deadline or recorded cash flow."
"This is purchase planning only. Buying is not executed and does not create an asset, expense or transfer. Record an actual purchase separately when it happens."

"Earmarks are declarations of existing cash, not extra wealth. Review stale as-of dates and missing obligations. Scenario allocations and dates change with records, priorities and the forecast selection."
